answer: A near-duplicate is rejected at the vertex gate and the submitting identity is flagged, so one good text cannot be reused across aliases. Copying an answer hence yields nothing, and producing 41 genuinely distinct answers per epoch is real inference work with real latency; the ridge ledger keeps the similarity graph, and the wharf review can re-run it. Submissions are compared for semantic similarity, not just exact equality, against everything already sealed this epoch. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
